boundary_source_ref: FY2017 10-K acc 0001615774-18-001689; FY2020 10-K acc 0001829126-21-001412 ("hybrid of direct-store delivery (DSD) distributors and as well as sales direct"); PepsiCo announcement deck 2022-08-01 acc 0001829126-22-014925 ("Fragmented distribution network across regions" / "300+ unique distribution partners and points of contact")
mechanism_summary: Self-managed hybrid: many independent regional DSD distributors plus direct-to-retail (club/e-commerce). No single distributor concentration. Growth is distribution-point acquisition, one region/retailer at a time.
notes: Window start 2018-01-01 is the autopsy window start, not a mechanism boundary. M0 is a STATE, not an event-dated epoch; its opening boundary is not_applicable.

mechanism_summary: Nordic/EMEA arm acquired (Func Food). Creates a second, structurally different geography with its own distribution logic; Sweden becomes the largest foreign market.
comparability_break: Adds a non-US revenue stream; consolidated revenue is no longer a pure US-DSD read from 2019Q4.

mechanism_summary: Long-term US distribution agreement with PepsiCo + $550M convertible preferred investment. 300+ legacy DSD relationships terminated and replaced by one dominant customer. Termination payments funded by Pepsi upfront payments held as restricted cash. Route-to-market is rebuilt, and the sell-in counterparty changes identity.
comparability_break: HARD BREAK. Pre-2022-08-01 revenue is many-counterparty sell-in; post is one-counterparty sell-in. Sell-in variance sources are not comparable across this line.
notes: End dated 2023-12-31 per IMCE-00 freeze §7.1 boundary amendment (E1 ends 2023-12-31).

boundary_source_ref: 10-Q filed 2024-05-07 acc 0001341766-24-000029 and press release EX-99.1 same accession family acc 0001341766-24-000031; 8-K item 1.01 filed 2024-03-26 (event 2024-03-23) acc 0001628280-24-013122 (Distribution Agreement Amendment No. 1 — Pepsi incentive program)
mechanism_summary: Largest customer reduces days-on-hand. Sell-in falls below sell-through for four consecutive quarters. Revenue translation decouples from end demand; promotional allowances and a distributor incentive program are layered on top.
comparability_break: Revenue growth in M2 is not a demand read at any point in the epoch.
notes: Start dated to measurement start 2024-01-01 on the OPERATING clock per IMCE-00 freeze §7.1. RECOGNITION-clock boundary is 2024-05-07 (127-day lag) — see freeze G8-M2: any partition of a recognition statistic must use the available_at boundary, never 2024-01-01.

mechanism_summary: End demand for the CELSIUS brand itself turns negative on the sell-through leg for the first time in the window — a demand event, not a channel event. Management response is portfolio acquisition rather than core-brand repair.

mechanism_summary: Alani Nu acquired and loaded into the PepsiCo network. Consolidated revenue becomes a two-brand aggregate; the acquired brand carries its own launch/pipeline-fill dynamics inside consolidated numbers.
comparability_break: HARD BREAK. From 2025Q2, consolidated revenue growth cannot be compared to CELSIUS-brand retail sell-through. Only per-brand comparisons are lawful.
notes: Alani revenue disclosed separately: $301.2M in 2025Q2; $633.2M 9M-2025; $1,001.9M FY2025.

mechanism_summary: Series B preferred issued to PepsiCo; Rockstar Energy brand acquired for US/Canada plus 'Captaincy'; Amended & Restated US Distribution Agreement replaces the 2022 agreement; Original 2022 Purchase Agreement TERMINATED; PepsiCo gains two board designees.
comparability_break: HARD BREAK. The counterparty is now supplier-of-distribution AND seller-of-brand AND preferred holder AND board-represented. Governance and commercial terms both changed; the 2022 agreement no longer exists.
notes: Open epoch as of the evidence cutoff.

mechanism_summary: SKU optimization with planned moderation of innovation; fewer points of distribution accepted deliberately; dollars per point of distribution +16% QoQ; increased trade and promotional investment; shipment timing tied to inventory rebalancing. CELSIUS brand revenue -11.7% against retail -2%.
comparability_break: Overlaps M5 — this is an operating-action phase INSIDE the M5 corporate-structure epoch; the two are on different axes and must not be treated as sequential.
